method: Instantiate real production scenes in Godot; transform all local Control rectangle corners by get_global_transform_with_canvas, then multiply by window-pixels/visible-viewport ratio and divide by displayDensity. Distinct large manual hit targets and 3D card ray-pick planes are measured separately.
isolation: XDG_DATA_HOME=/tmp/lumo-other-touch-density-review-data; unique child key; no existing child progress used or modified
cards_host_state: Existing cards_table_regression.wire_fixture supplies the JSON-roundtripped authoritative-state contract; native room, controls, card rendering and ray picking remain the production implementation.

findings.scope: play UI, four decision phases and scrolled modal controls; seven actual projected card hit planes
menu, menu scroll, active play lane input, pause button and pause menu; lane and pause use the same manually tested rectangles in production

findings.cause: RUNTIME.enter(self) keeps the legacy1280x720 content scale instead of fitting Android dp. On the configured surface the expanded viewport is1600x720, so a48-unit GUI button has72physical pixels, or27.42857dp.
states_measured: real clue answer modal opened through interaction action
findings.repair_scope_note: Density-aware viewport fitting must be accompanied by a check that the existing fixed-position modal and header still fit shorter dp heights; no product repair was attempted by this reviewer.

limits: This is a real headless layout/input measurement with an Android-density fixture, not a screenshot or a physical-device touch test.
Visibility is recorded separately from full rectangle size; partially clipped scrollable controls are not automatically classified as undersized.
No assertions about Android frame rate, touch latency or final release acceptance.
